proposal.rationale: The high-value-weekly-return-aware policy optimizes platform contribution while delivering strong merchant value. By combining targeted high-value timing, merchant familiarity, and observed return awareness, it outperforms broad outreach and indiscriminate spending, effectively scaling a supported intervention within the authorized envelope.

review.rationale: The proposed policy 'high-value-weekly-return-aware' demonstrates a credible mean platform improvement with a positive lower bound (1.51) and a strong nonnegative merchant contribution (mean 364.93, low 262.16). The addition of return awareness slightly improves the platform metrics compared to the non-return-aware weekly policy, making it a robust choice despite development uncertainty.

review.rationale: The proposed policy 'high-value-weekly-return-aware' demonstrates a credible mean platform improvement (7.17) with a positive 95% confidence lower bound (1.51) and a strong nonnegative merchant contribution (mean 364.93, low 262.16). The inclusion of the return-aware filter and weekly scheduling appears to effectively manage risk while driving positive outcomes.

proposal.rationale: Targeting high-value items early in the week, combined with merchant loyalty and return-awareness, maximizes platform contribution (mean 7.17) while delivering strong merchant value (mean 364.94). This targeted approach outperforms broad outreach by efficiently allocating the budget and mitigating return risks.

review.rationale: The proposed policy `high-value-weekly-return-aware` demonstrates a credible platform improvement (mean +7.17, 95% CI [1.51, 12.82]) and a strong, nonnegative merchant contribution (mean +364.93). The inclusion of return-awareness and weekly targeting appears to effectively manage risk while driving positive outcomes for both the platform and merchants. Acknowledging development uncertainty, the lower bounds of the confidence intervals remain positive, supporting the selection of this policy. Evidence ID: DEV-9b57e1446c2f1c50.

inferenceAccounting: Each alternative market is conservatively charged the largest observed cost of a fresh two-call agent approval. Only3 real approval trials were generated; the80 executions are not80 fresh LLM decisions.
boundary: Economic equations, customer responses and fees are unchanged. Policy authority expanded from isolated7-day/$5 pilots to recurring campaigns over70 days with a$50 virtual budget, equally for controls. The selected program uses no discounts. This is modeled value, not actual PayPal profit. The numerical policy without LLM selection gets the same commerce outcome at lower inference cost.

warehouse.name: simulation_runs
warehouse.description: One reproducible simulation and its clock. All dates use Asia/Manila business dates.

warehouse.name: merchants
warehouse.description: Fictional merchants. All sandbox receipts settle to the one connected test store.

warehouse.name: products
warehouse.description: Catalog snapshot. Sample or Channel3 provenance, provider ID, observed price and assumed unit cost.

warehouse.name: customers
warehouse.description: Synthetic shoppers and segments; no personal data.

warehouse.name: campaigns
warehouse.description: Campaign definitions and planner-authored copy in workflows. Merchant coupons and marketing spend are simulated.

warehouse.name: events
warehouse.description: Impressions, views, carts, purchases, deliveries and refunds, with event timestamps and foreign keys.

warehouse.name: orders
warehouse.description: Generated purchase records; currency and all monetary fields reconcile in integer cents.

warehouse.name: order_items
warehouse.description: Product and quantity lines joined to each order.

warehouse.name: transactions
warehouse.description: Simulated payment ledger. Never sum these with the mirrored sandbox receipts.

warehouse.name: refunds
warehouse.description: Simulated buyer returns. These do not issue PayPal refunds.

warehouse.name: deliveries
warehouse.description: Simulated completed deliveries.

warehouse.name: inventory_movements
warehouse.description: Signed stock movements: sale negative, restock positive.

warehouse.name: campaign_spend
warehouse.description: Simulated ad cost, never charged to an ad platform.

warehouse.name: paypal_receipts
warehouse.description: Actual sandbox API receipts for a bounded sample of orders. Fictitious funds; actual provider IDs and fees.

warehouse.name: business_goals
warehouse.description: Operator objective and simulated budget. Discounts reduce sale proceeds; only outreach is additionally subtracted from contribution.

warehouse.name: campaign_assignments
warehouse.description: Persistent randomized treatment eligibility versus holdout. Assignment precedes outcomes; non-targeted treatment customers remain in the denominator.

warehouse.name: coupons
warehouse.description: One-day, single-shopper simulated offers. Ordinary seasons use merchant-funded coupons; Policy Lab explicitly models80% merchant/20% platform funding. No real retailer coupons are issued.

warehouse.name: coupon_redemptions
warehouse.description: One redemption per coupon, linked to the actual simulated order and discount.

warehouse.name: customer_days
warehouse.description: Pre-action observed features followed by that day’s offer and purchase outcome. Hidden preferences are excluded.

warehouse.name: model_runs
warehouse.description: Real CPU training runs, chronological validation, dataset hash, candidate metrics and portable fitted artifacts.

warehouse.name: model_scores
warehouse.description: Model-versioned purchase probabilities under 0%, 5% and 10% offers. These are our predictions, not Channel3 customer scores.

warehouse.name: team_decisions
warehouse.description: Recorded decisions with evidence and reasons. Source distinguishes scripted seasons from assistant-in-chat workflow planning; no app-hosted LLM is invoked.

warehouse.name: retention_results
warehouse.description: Mature 14-day randomized intent-to-treat outcomes among customers active at assignment; includes uncertainty and signed lift.

warehouse.name: policy_comparisons
warehouse.description: Matched-world comparisons under the same seed, catalog and shocks. Simulation evidence only.

warehouse.name: recommendation_models
warehouse.description: Fitted local affinity/popularity counts, frozen cutoff, chronological Recall@3 comparison, dataset hash and model artifact. Scores are rankings, not purchase probabilities.

warehouse.name: recommendations
warehouse.description: One customer/product exposure with its ranked alternatives, model, decision checkpoint, click and optional same-day order. Full-price recommendations cost an assumed 2 cents each. Association is not causal lift.

warehouse.name: marketing_planner_calls
warehouse.description: Actual continuous-planner LLM attempts: dated evidence, function output, public rationale, validation status, provider token receipt and estimated cost. Local workers and simulated shoppers are not counted as LLM decisions.

warehouse.name: agent_workflows
warehouse.description: Durable campaign missions and workflow state. Planner attribution distinguishes current-chat decisions from scripted demo coordination; tools execute locally.

warehouse.name: agent_checkpoints
warehouse.description: Idempotent tool requests, planner rationale, evidence references, attempts, status and saved outputs.

warehouse.name: campaign_plans
warehouse.description: Validated, versioned campaign specifications tied to real locally fitted models and bounded simulation budgets.

warehouse.name: campaign_customer_decisions
warehouse.description: One recorded decision per shopper and campaign day: observed inputs, model scores, inclusion/exclusion reason, coupon and model lineage.

warehouse.name: planner_sessions
warehouse.description: App-owned autonomous planner status and immutable per-campaign model-spend allowance. No credentials.

warehouse.name: planner_turns
warehouse.description: Persisted model inputs, public decisions, validated requests, provider token receipts and execution outcomes. Saved proposals resume without another inference call.

warehouse.name: paypal_operations
warehouse.description: Checkpointed agent choices and native PayPal API outcomes. Draft invoices and pending subscriptions are not payments. Scenario requests are labeled in evidence_json.

warehouse.name: paypal_money_events
warehouse.description: Verified native sandbox capture, refund and payout states. Provider timestamps are wall-clock time; these are samples, never additional simulated sales.

warehouse.name: policy_lab_runs
warehouse.description: Paired economy branches. Same seed, initial state and exogenous draws; settings and assumptions are frozen at creation.

warehouse.name: policy_lab_checkpoints
warehouse.description: Persisted LLM requests, evidence, decisions, provider usage and execution status. Public rationales, not private chain of thought.

warehouse.name: policy_lab_models
warehouse.description: Actual locally fitted contextual ridge bandits. Only mature past rewards enter fitting; temporal validation and coefficients are saved.

warehouse.name: policy_lab_merchants
warehouse.description: Independent numerical merchant policies: own stock and margins determine acceptable discounts. These actors are not LLMs.

warehouse.name: policy_lab_actions
warehouse.description: One shopper decision per day, including no action; eligible actions and selection propensity, linked order, intervention costs and delayed reward.

warehouse.name: policy_lab_daily
warehouse.description: Daily simulated commerce and modeled economic outcomes. Whole-market paired comparisons are simulator effects, not real customer ROI.

warehouse.name: v_marketing_transactions
warehouse.description: Orders + merchant + customer + campaign + simulated payment/refund + optional native sandbox receipt.

warehouse.name: v_daily_merchant_sales
warehouse.description: Sales-cohort date totals with ad spend. Refunds are attributed back to the original sale date.

warehouse.name: v_campaign_performance
warehouse.description: Campaign funnel, retained revenue, spend and ROAS; no causal incrementality claim.

warehouse.name: v_marketing_funnel
warehouse.description: Date × merchant × channel funnel counts.

warehouse.name: v_inventory
warehouse.description: Opening stock + signed movements = on-hand stock.

warehouse.name: v_customer_segments
warehouse.description: Segment-level purchases and retained revenue.

warehouse.name: v_coupon_journey
warehouse.description: Coupon → customer → merchant → Channel3 product → redemption → order → simulated payment.

warehouse.name: v_learning_daily
warehouse.description: Observed daily activity and live campaign outcomes, including offer cost and recorded purchase labels.

warehouse.name: v_model_history
warehouse.description: Model training and promotion history; real local CPU runtimes and validation losses.

warehouse.name: v_retention_experiments
warehouse.description: Randomized treatment/control retention rates. An estimate of aggregate prevented inactivity, never an individual saved-customer claim.

warehouse.name: v_recommendation_journey
warehouse.description: Recommendation → simulated click → optional same-day order → modeled transaction → optional native PayPal receipt. Provider and simulated amounts must not be added.

warehouse.name: v_paypal_order_lineage
warehouse.description: One row per selected emulator order: Channel3 product IDs, coupon, synthetic merchant/customer, and verified native PayPal sandbox order/capture/fees. Provider timestamps and modeled amounts remain separate. Never add mirrored provider gross to simulated revenue.

warehouse.name: v_paypal_agent_actions
warehouse.description: Agent rationale and evidence cutoff joined to Channel3 product, shopper, merchant and actual PayPal operation. No secrets or wallet tokens.

warehouse.name: v_policy_customer_journey
warehouse.description: Customer → policy/model → offer → order → simulated transaction/refund → optional PayPal sandbox receipt. Native samples are mirrors, not additional sales.
